chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Abān, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام regarding the saying of Allah, Blessed and Exalted.
And whoever earns a good deed, We increase for him therein goodness.
He عليه السلام said: "The earning is submission to us, truthfulness concerning us, and that one should not lie against us."

key_terms.التَّسْلِيمُ: submission; yielding in acceptance to the authority of the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.الصِّدْقُ: truthfulness; speaking truthfully concerning the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.الِاقْتِرَافُ: the act of earning or acquiring; the Imam’s interpretive focus in the verse
key_terms.حَسَنَةً: a good deed; here interpreted in relation to loyalty and truthfulness toward the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.يَقْتَرِفْ: to acquire or earn; here, to attain a praiseworthy act
key_terms.يَكْذِبَ: to lie; here, to falsely attribute statements or claims to the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام interpret “And whoever earns a good deed, We increase for him therein goodness”?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about earning a good deed as referring to submission to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, speaking truthfully about them, and refraining from fabricating lies against them. It presents the verse as highlighting the spiritual merit of sincere wilayah and honesty regarding the Imams عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High
[42:23] and whoever earns good, We Give him more of good therein
. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The earning, is the submission to us<sup>asws</sup>, and the truthfulness upon us<sup>asws</sup>, and that he would not be lying upon us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, “Whoever achieves virtue will have its merit increased. . .” [42:23]
The Imam (a.s.) said, ‘achievement’ refers to one’s submission to us, his speaking the truth from us and not to ascribe any lies to us.”
